title: EN71 还是 EN1176？
titleEn: EN71 or EN1176? The Safety Standards You Must Know
desc: 搞清楚两个最常被问的认证——别再用玩具标准糊弄户外客户了。

lines.speaker: james
lines.en: Quick quiz, Emma. What is the difference between EN71 and EN1176?
lines.cn: 快速问答，Emma。EN71 和 EN1176 有什么区别？

lines.speaker: emma
lines.en: EN71 is the toy safety standard. It covers small parts, heavy metals, flammability.
lines.cn: EN71 是玩具安全标准。覆盖小零件、重金属、阻燃。

lines.speaker: emma
lines.en: EN1176 is for outdoor playground equipment. Fall height, use zone, impact attenuation. Totally different.
lines.cn: EN1176 是户外游乐设备。下落高度、自由空间、缓冲。完全不同。

lines.speaker: james
lines.en: I have seen some factories trying to use EN71 reports for slides.
lines.cn: 我见过有些厂拿 EN71 报告糊弄滑梯。

lines.speaker: emma
lines.en: Wrong. A slide over 1 meter fall height must have EN1176. Otherwise European customs will reject it.
lines.cn: 错。超过 1 米下落高度的滑梯必须 EN1176。否则欧洲海关扣货。

lines.speaker: emma
lines.en: Around swings, two meters. Under a 1.5 meter fall height, you need five centimeters of EPDM or 30 centimeters of sand.
lines.cn: 秋千周围 2 米。1.5 米下落高度下，需要 5 厘米 EPDM 或 30 厘米沙。

lines.speaker: james
lines.en: So which labs issue these reports?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.en: TUV Rheinland, SGS, Intertek. The report must be in English, stamped by ILAC. Chinese reports do not work.
lines.cn: TUV 莱茵、SGS、Intertek。报告必须英文，盖 ILAC 章。中文报告老外不认。

lines.speaker: james
lines.en: CE marking is just the self-declaration on top, right?
lines.cn: CE 标志就是上面的自我声明？

lines.speaker: emma
lines.en: Exactly. CE is your DoC, backed by valid EN reports. No shortcuts.
lines.cn: 对。CE 是你的 DoC，背后必须有有效 EN 报告。没捷径。
